name: Isocon Licitações Inteligentes
currentPhase: Local intelligence, edital ingestion and documentary compliance workflows
problem: Companies must repeatedly discover opportunities, read long edital documents, identify mandatory requirements and prove compliance with distributed company records.
solution: An installable procurement application that synchronises edital catalogues, extracts PDF content, identifies requirements and connects them to the company's documentary base using local AI.

localIntelligence.privacy: The access credential is not sent to the local model.

commercialValue: Private analysis on the user's device
